name: Extremis-level Threat
summary: Once per battle in your Command phase: until your next Command phase, models with Oath of Moment also re-roll the Wound roll (not just the Hit roll) against your Oath of Moment target.

name: Mastered Doctrines
summary: Up to 3 times per battle, pick an unused Combat Doctrine until your next Command phase: shoot after Advancing, shoot/charge after falling back, or charge after Advancing. Repeats need Marneus Calgar. Army: Ultramarines only.

name: Wrath of Dorn
summary: Attacks against your Oath of Moment target from models with Oath of Moment re-roll a Wound roll of 1; a Darnath Lysander unit's attacks against that target re-roll the Wound roll entirely. Army: Imperial Fists only.

name: Close-range Eradication
summary: Adeptus Astartes ranged weapons gain Assault, and get +1 Strength when their attack targets a unit within 12 inches.

name: Skystrike
summary: Land Speeder and Storm Speeder Hailstrike/Hammerstrike/Thunderstrike units count as Speeder; in your first Movement phase, friendly Speeder units can make an ingress move.

name: Calculated Annihilation
summary: Attacks against your Oath of Moment target from models with the Oath of Moment ability re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

name: Recalculating
summary: Once per battle round, if Caanok Var is on the battlefield, when your Oath of Moment target is destroyed you can pick a new visible enemy unit as your Oath of Moment target.

name: Psychic Disciplines
summary: Each battle round, pick a Discipline for friendly Astartes Psyker units until round end: Biomancy +2in M; Divination re-roll hit/wound 1s; Pyromancy +1 AP within 12in; Telekinesis -1 S vs ranged; Telepathy ignores BS/WS/hit modifiers.

name: Rapid-drop Deployment
summary: At deployment, a battle-size-scaled number of non-Titanic Adeptus Astartes units gain Deep Strike. A unit set up this turn re-rolls a Wound roll of 1; one that disembarked from a Drop Pod this turn also re-rolls a Hit roll of 1.

name: Oath of Reclamation
summary: Adeptus Astartes melee attacks near an objective get +1 AP. Attacks against an Adeptus Astartes unit holding a controlled objective get -1 to Wound if stronger than its Toughness (or unit has Titus). Army: Ultramarines only.

name: Masters of Shadow
summary: A ranged attack against an Adeptus Astartes unit from beyond 12 inches gives that unit Benefit of Cover.

name: Unparalleled Tactician
summary: Once per battle round, if Aethon Shaan is on the battlefield, you can use the Into Darkness Stratagem for 0 Command Points.

name: Storm-swift Onslaught
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Wrath of the First Khan
summary: At the end of the Fight phase, if a Suboden Khan unit destroyed an enemy unit this phase and isn't engaged, it can make a Normal move of up to 6 inches.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Shadow Masters
summary: A ranged attack against an Adeptus Astartes unit from beyond 12 inches gives that unit Benefit of Cover.

name: Imperator Unleashed
summary: After a Fly Infantry unit makes an ingress or charge move this turn, its attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
